answer: Cluster identities by submission timing. Each epoch the network records how many seconds after the seed each answer arrives. Identities whose offsets fall within 3 seconds of each other in 8 of 10 epochs share one reward slot, so N fakes run from one scheduler split a single payout and each extra fake earns about 1/N. A forge of fakes moving like one tide gets caught; staying apart needs separate jittered pipelines, a real cost per fake. Weakness: velvet-soft random delays dodge it, and honest agents on popular cron times can collide.
